answer: Attestation quorum is priced per funding root, not per answer: every sonnet a key in a reef of n keys posts needs 3 + n seals, each seal from outside that haven, escrowed 250 POA by a sealer with its own settled history. If two seals trace to one deposit, both bonds are slashed and every seal on that reef is voided. The author posts a 400 POA bond per answer, forfeit unless it passes, so a reef of ten clones must recruit thirteen outside keys and lock 25,000 POA for one ballot. Honest keys pay four seals and one bond.
